prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: I thought the market was on the square today.
spokenPromptZh: 我以為市集今天在廣場。

options.text: It moved indoors because of the wind.
options.zh: 因為風勢，市集移到室內了。
options.whyZh: 交代當天場地和預期不同的原因。

options.text: I usually bring a shopping bag on Fridays.
options.zh: 我星期五通常會帶購物袋。
options.whyZh: 只談個人習慣，未釐清今天的地點。

options.text: The florist’s stall sells dried flowers, too.
options.whyZh: 只說花攤賣什麼，沒確認或更正市集地點。

explanationZh: 交代當天場地和預期不同的原因。
evidence: I thought the market was on the square today. / It moved indoors because of the wind.
